userFacing.summary: The GitHub theme family joins as the 17th built-in pair: github (Primer light — white ground, #1F2328 ink, #0969DA accent, green primary buttons, README-style h1/h2 bottom rules) and github-dark (Primer dark — #0D1117 ground, #F0F6FC ink, #4493F8 accent) with Prism code-highlight companions, registered across the theme list, the native View › Theme menu, the command palette, Settings › Appearance and all ten locales; the site diagram gallery theme table carries both (34 themes, 17 dark / 17 light).

acceptance.testedArtifact: None — owner accepted without a separate visual check; evidence: automated contrast tests, rendered-pixel check of both variants, and code review of an additive-only diff (owner-reviewed implementation 8015e4ef; the CI-caught site-gallery and e2e count repairs eaf8890c/9485bae5 landed before the fully green PR #66 run).
scenarios: theme-contrast gate: full paper variable parity and WCAG AA floors (editorColor/linkColor ≥ 4.5:1, blockquote text ≥ 3:1) for github and github-dark

registration pins: themeMap/themeCssFactories, THEME_FAMILIES 17 families / 34 members, the command palette, the native View › Theme menu, the Settings Appearance grid (17 tiles) and menu.theme names in all 10 locales
rendered-pixel check of both variants against the GitHub Primer palette on a real render (implementing-session evidence, owner-reviewed diff)
site diagram gallery: the regenerated theme table classifies github-dark dark (34 themes, 17/17) and the strip shows GitHub / GitHub Dark with brand casing

userFacing.summary: One notification system: every transient message renders as a single severity-styled card (colored status chip, four severities, all theme tokens) in one bottom-right stack — max three visible with a localized overflow counter, sticky errors, hover-paused auto-dismiss, Esc closes the topmost; selecting text in any notification copies it (quiet double-pulse confirmation); a palette command recovers everything shown during the session with full texts and per-entry copy; the update banner and the per-file message strip join the same family; the legacy toast implementation and dead pandoc-missing code are removed.

acceptance.testedArtifact: None — owner merged PR #72 on instruction without a separate visual check; evidence: the visual acceptance record in the change bundle (pixel-exact chip tint in Paper and Ink, no-stripe edges, timer hairline), a 6-test e2e probe, full CI green after the label admission (17 checks), and vitest 370 files / 5029 passed on the merge candidate.
scenarios: visual probe: chip tint equals the exact 14% severity token blend in Paper and Ink; card edges stripe-free; timer hairline color-exact
stack behavior: five notifications render three cards plus the 'More 2 notifications' overflow chip; errors never auto-dismiss; Esc closes only the topmost without stealing the editor's Escape
copy-on-select: scripted selection release writes exactly the selected words and leaves the card open; double green pulse only, no labels
session history: the palette command lists notifications newest-first with full untruncated text and a per-entry copy action
regression pins: the C-66 update notice keeps Update/Later/Skip semantics on the shared card; the file-changed banner keeps its queue flow; all ten locales carry the new keys as native copy
